_meta.description: Heart event #3 for npc_leera: The Secret Ruin

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Jack. I want to show you something. Follow me.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: I found this place two years ago. Never told anyone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Leera leads you to a hidden clearing with a pre-war observatory]

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: An observatory. The roof's gone but the telescope still works.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: On clear nights you can see... everything. The whole sky.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: I come here when the world feels too small.

options.text: It's beautiful. Thank you for sharing this.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Because you're the only person who'd understand.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Most people see ruins and think 'salvage.' You see... possibility.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Same as me. We're the same kind of crazy.
